column1: # Real-file corpus for the own FBX / COLLADA / 3DS / BVH / OBJ / STL / PLY / glTF / 3MF readers: what each reader gave on each file when this
# manifest was written. The files are not in this repository (see docs/model_corpus.md): they come from the
# test/models and test/models-nonbsd directories of an Assimp 5.4.3 source checkout; paths below are relative to
# that checkout's "test" directory (OKAY_MODEL_CORPUS points at it). Tab separated:
#   reader  path  ok|FAIL  then the counts (meshes, tris, bones, skinned, clips, mat = materials) the test compares, or the error.
# Regenerate with: for r in fbx-own dae 3ds bvh obj stl ply gltf 3mf; do test_model_corpus --list $r <test dir>; done  (keep only the models/ and models-nonbsd/ rows, drop the ms= column)

# obj / stl / ply / gltf rows also record tex (distinct texture files), nodes, uv and nrm (1 when some mesh has per-vertex UVs / normals); gltf sizes are the file's own (the importer's auto-scale is undone).
